entities.summary: Rage is a subgenre of trap music that originated in the United States in the late 2010s. Distinguishing features of rage include short, looping, stereo-widened, future bass-influenced synthesizer lead hooks and basic, energetic trap rhythms. Among the pioneers of the early rage style were Playboi Carti, Lil Uzi Vert and Trippie Redd.
